'''Leish''' is married to [[Taril Canler]] and currently lives in the [[Black Tower]].

== Appearance ==
Leish has white hair, is plump and pleasant.

== Activities ==
Canler has [[Bond]]ed Leish. She helps set up the plan for [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and [[Androl Genhald]] to capture [[Dobser]].

== Trivia ==
* Leish is named for Leisha Springer, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
